airdrops.name: Merkle dataset example
airdrops.notes: Dataset paths are relative to this registry file. 'auto' leaf encoding is detected by testing the file's proofs against merkleRoot().

airdrops.name: Per-address claim API example
airdrops.notes: The API response must contain index/amount/proof. Proofs are verified against the on-chain root before being trusted; a 404 is treated as 'not in the list', not as an error.

airdrops.name: On-chain allocation view example
airdrops.notes: Use when the distributor stores the allocation itself. No dataset needed; root_method is disabled with an empty string.
